title: Let your assistant start the handoff.
dek: Your assistant prepares the instructions and requests the setting. You supply the value outside the conversation.

margin.title: Name, not value
margin.text: Your assistant can discuss DATABASE_URL without seeing the connection string.

margin.title: Start harmlessly
margin.text: Use the practice setting before introducing a real credential.

title: Try it with a harmless value.
dek: Walk through the command once, using a setting that cannot unlock anything.

margin.title: Practice value
margin.text: not-a-secret is deliberately harmless. Keep real credentials out of screenshots and chat.

margin.title: After saving
margin.text: A saved file does not establish that your program has loaded it.

title: Trigger the next step.
dek: Exact commands for displaying a guide, registering a request and checking status, with their availability made explicit.

margin.title: Preview contract
margin.text: Keyhole requests and secret_status are implemented on an unreleased branch. Version 0.1.0 supports manual entry only.

margin.title: Names cross
margin.text: Requests carry names and instructions. The person supplies the value in VS Code.

title: Connect your assistant to Render.
dek: Choose browser authorization or an API key, then give the Render MCP server the access it needs.

margin.title: Before granting access
margin.text: An MCP server can act on your services. Review its permissions and approve only the task you intend.

margin.title: Documentation checked
margin.text: Official sources reviewed on 24 October 2026. This guide has not been tested against a signed-in account.

title: Connect your assistant to Neon.
dek: Authorize the hosted MCP server, or choose an API key when your client needs one. A database connection string is a separate setting.

margin.title: Two credentials
margin.text: A Neon API key manages Neon resources. DATABASE_URL connects an application to a database.

margin.title: Documentation checked
margin.text: Official sources reviewed on 24 October 2026. This guide has not been tested against a signed-in account.

title: Put it where the server reads it.
dek: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build have different environment and MCP configuration paths.

margin.title: Writer status
margin.text: Keyhole currently writes .env. The harness-specific destinations here are configuration references, not supported Keyhole writers yet.

margin.title: No universal loader
margin.text: A shell setting and an MCP setting can affect different processes. Saved does not mean loaded.

title: Keep secrets out of the conversation.
dek: Choose the application running your assistant, then check its protections before adding a real key.

margin.title: Checked 20 October
margin.text: These recipes were checked against documentation and source. They have not been exercised here in running assistants.

margin.title: Test harmlessly
margin.text: A passing check covers the tested routes and setup. It is not proof about every tool or future version.

title: When a step stops you.
dek: Find the message or symptom, then check the next step without exposing the value.

margin.title: When asking for help
margin.text: Share the variable name and the message. Leave out the value, .env contents, and revealed screenshots.

margin.title: Local settings
margin.text: Writing a local .env does not configure a hosted service.
